propositions: The enrich_drain gate's pending_enrichment check is O(ticket count) because it calls reduce_ticket on every ticket dir, each issuing ~5 metadata syscalls, causing 600-740 ms latency on writes against a 20 ms budget.

The gate runs on every rebar write when verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets is on, causing the budget-breach warning to fire 100% of the time and become an invisible noise signal rather than an actionable operator alert.
Concurrent writes self-contend on the gate's 24,000-metadata-syscall walk, causing superlinear latency degradation under load (measured up to 3.6x slowdown with 16 concurrent walkers).

An O(1) marker stored at .rebar/enrich-gate.json holding next_eligible_ns can answer the gate check on quiet stores without a full scan, with self-healing via TTL expiry, invalidation on queue mutations, and degradation to full scan on any marker corruption.
Genuine soaked entries remain correctly detected because the marker can only suppress probes when the store is provably empty, never manufacture false negatives.
